question: Should the dashboard-design workflow be an external ClawHub skill that consumes a reviewed dashboard/preview screenshot API, or should OpenClaw bundle it with the dashboard plugin?
rationale: VISION.md prefers new skills through ClawHub, while this request also needs a security-sensitive screenshot capability that maintainers must scope before implementation.

options.title: ClawHub Skill After Screenshot API
options.body: Keep OpenClaw work limited to the reviewed screenshot/inspection API, then publish the dashboard-design procedure as a ClawHub skill once that API is stable.

options.title: Bundle With Dashboard Plugin
options.body: Sponsor the skill as official bundled dashboard behavior and require explicit security, ownership, and product proof before landing it.

options.title: Defer Until Dashboard Stack Lands
options.body: Leave this leaf parked until the dashboard workspace and preview-widget directions are accepted on main.

recommendation.title: ClawHub Skill After Screenshot API
recommendation.body: Keep OpenClaw work limited to the reviewed screenshot/inspection API, then publish the dashboard-design procedure as a ClawHub skill once that API is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is the recently merged plugin-tab precedent and related browser-preview product/security discussion.
